## Overview

This is a legacy script from the earlier all-site analysis (primary tumours plus metastatic biopsies from bone, lymph node and soft tissue). It is included for transparency and is not part of the bone-only pipeline. It was an exploratory pass over all four timepoints (archival, pre-treatment, on-treatment, progression). It used TMM log-CPM without RUV, because the on-treatment and progression timepoints were never taken through the RUV pipeline. With singscore it scored a 13-gene NEPC panel adapted from Beltran et al., a five-gene AR-pathway panel, and the Hallmark androgen response, MYC targets and IFN-γ response sets. It related the NEPC score to response group in tumour segments, correlated NEPC with AR scores in PSMA⁺ AOIs, and plotted patient-level trajectories.

The per-AOI scores (`data/previous_analysis/Phase8_NEPC_Longitudinal/all_scores_per_AOI.csv`, frozen) are read by comp_18. comp_18 tests whether the earlier reported correlation of the NEPC score with PSMA-PET tumour growth holds with AOIs or patients as observations. All tests in this script are at AOI level and do not account for repeated AOIs per patient.

**Figures, tables and results supported**

- Results: Re-evaluation of earlier neuroendocrine findings (NEPC score versus PSMA-PET tumour growth at AOI versus patient level), via comp_18 reading the frozen `data/previous_analysis/Phase8_NEPC_Longitudinal/all_scores_per_AOI.csv`
- Supports the reconciliation shown in Extended Data Fig. 8 (comp_18)

**Pipeline step:** `./run_pipeline.sh --legacy` (optional; not needed to reproduce the current analysis, whose frozen inputs are in `data/previous_analysis/`). Approximate runtime: a few minutes.

**Inputs**

- `data/interim/phase2_se_qc_filtered.qs`

**Outputs**

- `results_legacy/previous_analysis/Phase8_NEPC_Longitudinal/all_scores_per_AOI.csv (frozen copy in data/previous_analysis/Phase8_NEPC_Longitudinal/)`
- `results_legacy/phase8_nepc_longitudinal_results.rds`
- `results_legacy/Results/Phase8_NEPC_Longitudinal/NEPC_vs_AR_scatter.pdf`
- `results_legacy/Results/Phase8_NEPC_Longitudinal/traj_{NEPC,AR,MYC,IFN,FOLH1}.pdf`

**Depends on**: `comp_00a`

## Analysis

### Legacy exploratory NEPC and longitudinal analysis

The header gives the scope caveat (no RUV; hypothesis-generating) and the NEPC and AR panels.

Loads the all-site QC-filtered object without control AOIs and computes TMM log-CPM over all genes. AOIs are scored with singscore `simpleScore` (up-set only) for the NEPC panel, the AR panel and Hallmark androgen, MYC and IFN-γ sets, and *FOLH1* and *AR* expression is stored.

```{r phase8-nepc-longitudinal-01}
## ============================================================================
## PRINCE Trial GeoMx DSP -- Exploratory: NEPC signal + longitudinal trajectories
##
## Exploratory analyses: (1) longitudinal differences across all 4
## timepoints (Archival/Screening/Cycle1/DiseaseProgression), (2) exploration
## of neuroendocrine prostate cancer (NEPC) transdifferentiation as a candidate
## resistance mechanism and its relationship to response.
##
## SCOPE CAVEAT (stated explicitly, not buried): Cycle1 and DiseaseProgression
## were never taken through the full Phase 3 RUV-4/RUV-III-PRPS pipeline (that
## was scoped to Archival+Screening only, for Q1). This script uses simple
## TMM+log2CPM normalization (no RUV) across all 4 timepoints so trajectories
## can be shown -- it is an EXPLORATORY, lighter-weight pass, not a Phase-4-grade
## DE result. Treat patterns here as hypothesis-generating even more so than the
## Phase 4/5 findings.
##
## NEPC marker panel: adapted from the classic Beltran et al. (2016, Nat Med)
## NEPC signature -- up in NEPC: ASCL1, SOX2, NKX2-1, FOXA2, INSM1, CHGA, CHGB,
## SYP, NCAM1, EZH2, AURKA, MYCN, PCSK1; down in NEPC (AR-pathway): AR, KLK3,
## FOLH1 (=PSMA -- directly relevant, since PSMA loss undermines the trial's
## own drug target), NKX3-1, HOXB13. This is a curated literature panel, not a
## validated deconvolution reference -- treated as a score, not a diagnosis.
## ============================================================================

suppressMessages({
  library(qs); library(SummarizedExperiment); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)
  library(edgeR); library(singscore); library(ggplot2); library(GSEABase)
})

PRINCE_ROOT <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("PRINCE_ROOT", "."))
RAW_DIR <- file.path(PRINCE_ROOT, "data", "interim")     # all-site QC'd objects written by comp_00a_qc
dir.create(file.path(PRINCE_ROOT, "results_legacy"), showWarnings = FALSE)
setwd(file.path(PRINCE_ROOT, "results_legacy"))           # legacy outputs; frozen copies used downstream are in data/previous_analysis
dir.create("Results/Phase8_NEPC_Longitudinal", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

se <- qs::qread(file.path(RAW_DIR, "phase2_se_qc_filtered.qs"))
cd <- as.data.frame(colData(se))
idx <- cd$response_group_neat != "Control"
se <- se[, idx]
cd <- droplevels(as.data.frame(colData(se)))
cd$timepoint <- factor(cd$timepoint, levels = c("Archival", "Screening", "Cycle1", "DiseaseProgression"))

counts <- assay(se, "all_count")
dge <- DGEList(counts); dge <- calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")
logcpm <- edgeR::cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = 0.5)  # genes x AOIs

nepc_up <- c("ASCL1","SOX2","NKX2-1","FOXA2","INSM1","CHGA","CHGB","SYP","NCAM1","EZH2","AURKA","MYCN","PCSK1")
ar_down_in_nepc <- c("AR","KLK3","FOLH1","NKX3-1","HOXB13")
nepc_up <- intersect(nepc_up, rownames(logcpm))
ar_down_in_nepc <- intersect(ar_down_in_nepc, rownames(logcpm))
cat("NEPC-up genes available:", paste(nepc_up, collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("AR-pathway (down-in-NEPC) genes available:", paste(ar_down_in_nepc, collapse=", "), "\n")

hallmark <- msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H")
ar_hallmark <- intersect(hallmark$gene_symbol[hallmark$gs_name == "HALLMARK_ANDROGEN_RESPONSE"], rownames(logcpm))
myc_hallmark <- intersect(hallmark$gene_symbol[hallmark$gs_name == "HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS_V1"], rownames(logcpm))
ifn_hallmark <- intersect(hallmark$gene_symbol[hallmark$gs_name == "HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE"], rownames(logcpm))

rank_data <- rankGenes(logcpm)
score_nepc <- simpleScore(rank_data, upSet = nepc_up)$TotalScore
score_ar_small <- simpleScore(rank_data, upSet = ar_down_in_nepc)$TotalScore
score_ar_hallmark <- simpleScore(rank_data, upSet = ar_hallmark)$TotalScore
score_myc <- simpleScore(rank_data, upSet = myc_hallmark)$TotalScore
score_ifn <- simpleScore(rank_data, upSet = ifn_hallmark)$TotalScore

cd$score_nepc <- score_nepc
cd$score_ar_pathway_genes <- score_ar_small
cd$score_ar_hallmark <- score_ar_hallmark
cd$score_myc_proliferation <- score_myc
cd$score_ifn_gamma <- score_ifn
cd$FOLH1_logcpm <- logcpm["FOLH1", ]
cd$AR_logcpm <- if ("AR" %in% rownames(logcpm)) logcpm["AR", ] else NA

```

### NEPC versus response and AR

In PSMA⁺ and PanCK⁺PSMA⁻ AOIs at the archival and pre-treatment timepoints, the script fits `NEPC score ~ response group` at AOI level. It reports the correlations of NEPC with Hallmark AR, *FOLH1* and *AR* in PSMA⁺ AOIs and saves a scatter plot.

```{r phase8-nepc-longitudinal-02}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## NEPC vs response (cross-sectional, tumour segments), and NEPC vs AR correlation
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n================ NEPC SCORE vs RESPONSE GROUP (tumour segments) ================\n")
for (seg in c("PSMA+", "PanCK+PSMA-")) {
  for (tp in c("Archival", "Screening")) {
    sub <- cd %>% filter(segment_name == seg, timepoint == tp)
    fit <- lm(score_nepc ~ response_group_neat, data = sub)
    r2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared
    pval <- tryCatch(anova(fit)$`Pr(>F)`[1], error = function(e) NA)
    means <- tapply(sub$score_nepc, sub$response_group_neat, mean)
    cat(sprintf("%-12s / %-10s  R2=%.3f p=%.4f  means: %s\n", seg, tp, r2, pval,
                paste(names(means), round(means,4), sep="=", collapse=", ")))
  }
}

cat("\n================ NEPC vs AR-PATHWAY CORRELATION (PSMA+ segment, all timepoints) ================\n")
sub_psma <- cd %>% filter(segment_name == "PSMA+")
cat("cor(NEPC score, AR-hallmark score):", round(cor(sub_psma$score_nepc, sub_psma$score_ar_hallmark), 3), "\n")
cat("cor(NEPC score, FOLH1 logCPM):", round(cor(sub_psma$score_nepc, sub_psma$FOLH1_logcpm), 3), "\n")
cat("cor(NEPC score, AR logCPM):", round(cor(sub_psma$score_nepc, sub_psma$AR_logcpm, use="complete.obs"), 3), "\n")

p_cor <- ggplot(sub_psma, aes(score_ar_hallmark, score_nepc, color = response_group_neat)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  theme_bw() + labs(title = "NEPC score vs AR-pathway (Hallmark) score, PSMA+ segment",
                     x = "AR pathway score", y = "NEPC score")
ggsave("Results/Phase8_NEPC_Longitudinal/NEPC_vs_AR_scatter.pdf", p_cor, width = 6, height = 5)

```

### Longitudinal trajectories

Averaged per patient and timepoint in PSMA⁺ AOIs, the scores are plotted as individual trajectories with response-group means. Progression tissue exists only for responders. The script summarises the paired archival → on-treatment change by response group and writes the per-AOI score table that comp_18 later reads.

```{r phase8-nepc-longitudinal-03}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Longitudinal trajectories (patient-level mean per timepoint x segment)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n================ LONGITUDINAL: PATIENTS PER TIMEPOINT (PSMA+ segment) ================\n")
traj <- cd %>% filter(segment_name == "PSMA+") %>%
  group_by(subject_id, timepoint, response_group_neat) %>%
  summarise(nepc = mean(score_nepc), ar = mean(score_ar_hallmark),
            myc = mean(score_myc_proliferation), ifn = mean(score_ifn_gamma),
            folh1 = mean(FOLH1_logcpm), .groups = "drop")
print(as.data.frame(table(traj$timepoint, traj$response_group_neat)))

plot_traj <- function(df, yvar, ylab) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = timepoint, y = .data[[yvar]], group = subject_id, color = response_group_neat)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.4) + geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    stat_summary(aes(group = response_group_neat), fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.4) +
    theme_bw() + labs(title = paste(ylab, "over treatment course (PSMA+ segment)"),
                       subtitle = "Thin lines = individual patients; thick lines = group mean. DiseaseProgression tissue exists only for Responders (attrition).",
                       y = ylab, x = "Timepoint", color = "Response")
}
ggsave("Results/Phase8_NEPC_Longitudinal/traj_NEPC.pdf", plot_traj(traj, "nepc", "NEPC score"), width = 8, height = 5)
ggsave("Results/Phase8_NEPC_Longitudinal/traj_AR.pdf", plot_traj(traj, "ar", "AR pathway score"), width = 8, height = 5)
ggsave("Results/Phase8_NEPC_Longitudinal/traj_MYC.pdf", plot_traj(traj, "myc", "MYC/proliferation score"), width = 8, height = 5)
ggsave("Results/Phase8_NEPC_Longitudinal/traj_IFN.pdf", plot_traj(traj, "ifn", "IFN-gamma score"), width = 8, height = 5)
ggsave("Results/Phase8_NEPC_Longitudinal/traj_FOLH1.pdf", plot_traj(traj, "folh1", "FOLH1 (PSMA) log2CPM"), width = 8, height = 5)

## simple mixed-effect-ish test: does score change Archival->Cycle1 within patient (paired), by response
cat("\n================ PAIRED WITHIN-PATIENT CHANGE: Archival -> Cycle1 (PSMA+) ================\n")
wide <- traj %>% dplyr::select(subject_id, timepoint, response_group_neat, nepc, ar) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = c(nepc, ar), names_sep = "_")
paired <- wide %>% filter(!is.na(nepc_Archival), !is.na(nepc_Cycle1))
cat("N patients with both Archival and Cycle1 (PSMA+):", nrow(paired), "\n")
if (nrow(paired) >= 3) {
  paired$d_nepc <- paired$nepc_Cycle1 - paired$nepc_Archival
  paired$d_ar <- paired$ar_Cycle1 - paired$ar_Archival
  print(paired %>% group_by(response_group_neat) %>%
          summarise(n = n(), mean_d_nepc = mean(d_nepc), mean_d_ar = mean(d_ar)))
}

write.csv(cd %>% dplyr::select(subject_id, timepoint, segment_name, response_group_neat,
                         score_nepc, score_ar_hallmark, score_ar_pathway_genes,
                         score_myc_proliferation, score_ifn_gamma, FOLH1_logcpm, AR_logcpm),
          "Results/Phase8_NEPC_Longitudinal/all_scores_per_AOI.csv", row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(list(cd = cd, traj = traj), "phase8_nepc_longitudinal_results.rds")

cat("\nSaved phase8_nepc_longitudinal_results.rds, all_scores_per_AOI.csv, and trajectory/scatter plots",
    "under Results/Phase8_NEPC_Longitudinal/\n")
cat("Phase 8 (exploratory NEPC + longitudinal) script complete.\n")
```
